description: Revision is where your projects' tasks, decisions and documents live, and where ChatGPT keeps them up to date. Ask what changed since you were last here, look up why a decision was made before changing it, see your tasks across projects, and record decisions and lessons as you work. New tasks and task changes arrive as drafts you confirm in Revision, unless you allow applying them without confirmation on the consent screen. Document edits are saved as versions with a reason and can be reverted. Access is limited to the projects and permissions you grant when connecting.

defaultPrompt: Что изменилось в моих проектах с прошлого раза?
Почему мы так решили? Найди решение в памяти проекта.
Чем мне заняться сегодня по всем проектам?
